info.title: trackflow API
info.description: The API of trackflow, used by its web app, scripts and integrations. Conventions: snake_case JSON, one error format, cursor pagination.

post.summary: What a link is for, before it is used: the page shows whose it is or that it expired.

get.summary:
The jobs of «Задания» (ADM-031): newest first, keyset-paginated, with a state filter and
words matched against the kind and the initiator's name (ADM-032).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words matched against the kind and the initiator's name; a leading `-` excludes.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only jobs with a smaller id: keyset pagination, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; default 50.

200.description: A page of jobs, newest first

post.summary:
Cancels a job (ADM-031): a queued one at once, a running one only when its kind may be
cancelled; anything already final or not cancellable answers 409.

200.description: Cancelled, or the stop was requested; the job as it stands

post.summary:
Retries a failed job (ADM-032): a fresh one with the same kind and payload, the administrator
as its initiator. Anything not failed answers 409.

409.description: Only a failed job can be retried

get.summary: The mail settings of the instance, without any secret value (NTF-004).

put.summary:
Saves the mail settings (NTF-004, NTF-006): validates the whole set by building the transport
it names, then stores each change with its audit event. Switching email on (NTF-002) needs a
working transport. Needs `system.write`; storing a secret needs the instance key.

200.description: Saved; the settings as they stand now

400.description: The set names no working transport

403.description: No `system.write`, or no key to store secrets

post.summary:
Sends a test message to any address through the saved transport and answers the transport's
complaint in full (NTF-007). The switch does not gate it: an administrator tests before
switching email on. Needs `system.write`.

get.summary:
The settings of the «Настройки» screen: value, default and `is_stored` per key, the flags,
and the deployment's upload ceiling. The values come from the node's snapshot: current
without touching the database.

put.summary:
Saves a change set of the general settings (ADM-002): each present key changes, `null`
returns it to the default. One transaction, one audit event per key; every node reloads.
The mail settings refuse this API — they have their own.

200.description: Saved; the settings as they stand now

400.description: An unknown key or an invalid value

get.summary: One file the caller sees.

delete.summary: Deletes a file (CNT-024): it disappears and its links stop working at once.

patch.summary: Renames a file or changes whom it is limited to (CNT-020, CNT-023).

400.description: A bad or taken name, an unknown audience

409.description: Changed by someone else, or the project is archived

get.summary: Boards the caller views (BRD-001, BRD-002): favorites first, then by name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

post.summary: Creates a board from a preset (BRD-003…BRD-010).

403.description: A guest, or does not read issues in every project

get.summary: One board the caller views.

delete.summary: Deletes a board with its sprints and cards (BRD-016): the owner or an administrator.

403.description: Neither the owner nor an administrator

patch.summary:
Renames a board, changes its projects or column field, shares it or gives it to another owner
(BRD-010…BRD-013, BRD-042).

400.description: Invalid name, projects, field or audiences

403.description: May not edit, share or give it away

get.summary:
A page of the board's backlog (BRD-089…BRD-093): issues ordered by hand first, then the rest
in the search's sort; `missing` says why there is none.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The panel's filter, ANDed with the backlog search.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA name for dates in `q`; the instance's by default.

400.description: The filter has errors (`invalid_query`), or a bad limit or cursor

post.summary: Puts an issue at a place in the backlog's order (BRD-093): those who edit the backlog search.

400.description: A neighbour that is not in the backlog

403.description: No backlog, or may not edit its search

delete.summary: Forgets the backlog's order (BRD-093): the search's sort again.

403.description: No backlog, or may not edit its search

post.summary: Where these issues are on the board now (BRD-114): the live board asks after events.

get.summary: The rest of a truncated cell (BRD-057).

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: The lane of the cell, on a board with lanes.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The header filter the view was asked with.

404.description: No such board, sprint or column

post.summary:
The caller's draft of a cell (BRD-077): the kept one, or a new draft with the project's
defaults, the cell's column and lane, already a card that shows once published.

400.description: No such column or sprint, or a project off the board

403.description: May not create issues in a board project

post.summary: Adds a column (BRD-043): a value of the column field's set, or a new value of it (FLD-031).

400.description: Not a value of the set, a column already, or too many

403.description: May not edit the board or the set

409.description: The board has no column field

delete.summary: Removes a column: its cards leave the board and keep their sprint (BRD-043).

patch.summary: Moves a column, sets its WIP limits or renames its value (BRD-044…BRD-046).

403.description: May not edit the board or the set

409.description: The value was changed by someone else

get.summary: What deleting the board takes with it, to name before asking (BRD-016).

patch.summary: Changes the caller's view of a board: favorite, card size, collapsed columns and lanes.

get.summary: The sprints of a board, archived ones included (BRD-103).

post.summary: Creates a sprint (BRD-098): settings editors of a sprint board.

400.description: Invalid name, goal, dates or sprint to carry from

403.description: May not edit the board, or it has no sprints

delete.summary: Deletes a sprint with its cards (BRD-104); a sprint board keeps at least one.

403.description: May not edit the board, or its last sprint

patch.summary: Edits a sprint's name, goal and dates (BRD-102).

post.summary: Archives a sprint (BRD-103): it leaves detection and the suggestions.

Adds an issue to a sprint of the board (BRD-025); on a sprint board an issue in another
sprint moves to this one. An issue already there stays as it is.

400.description: Not an issue of a board project, or a bad neighbour

403.description: May not update the issue, or a query board

404.description: No such board, sprint or issue

delete.summary: Takes a card off the sprint (BRD-074); not on a query board.

403.description: May not update the issue, or a query board

404.description: No such board or sprint, or the issue is not on it

post.summary:
Moves a card (BRD-068, BRD-069): another column sets the column field's value, with the rights,
required values and history of a field change; the neighbours give its place.

400.description: No such column, a bad neighbour or a value the field refuses

404.description: No such board or sprint, or the issue is not on it

post.summary: Carries the unresolved issues of a sprint to another (BRD-101); answers the target.
Finishes a sprint by hand (D-013).

A new parent lane (BRD-054): an issue in the first board project with the first lane value
and the title as its summary, the last lane of the sprint. Parent-lane boards only.

400.description: A bad title or a value the field refuses

403.description: No parent lanes, a query board, or may not create issues

delete.summary:
Takes a parent lane back to the backlog (BRD-056): the parent and its subtasks leave the
sprint; each needs the update right. Not on a query board.

403.description: No parent lanes, a query board, or may not update an issue

404.description: No such board, sprint or issue

post.summary:
Puts a parent lane at another place (BRD-053): the board's edit right; only the order of lanes
changes, no field.

403.description: No parent lanes, or may not change the board

post.summary: Restores an archived sprint (BRD-103).
Starts a sprint by hand (D-013): it starts today unless it started already.

get.summary:
The board with one sprint's cards (BRD-068): the current sprint unless one is asked for
(BRD-099); each cell shows at most 100 cards (BRD-057).

parameters.name: sprint
parameters.description: A sprint of the board; absent shows the current one (BRD-099).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The header filter (BRD-081): any issue-list query, resolved within the board projects.

parameters.name: lanes
parameters.description: Where a page of lanes starts (`lanes_next`, BRD-057).

get.summary: What the web app needs before it renders. Available without signing in.
Capabilities and their groups (ACC-064). Needs `system.read`.

put.summary: Sets the groups a capability is on for (ACC-064). Needs `system.write`.

400.description: Unknown group, or the list may not be empty

get.summary: One comment; a placeholder when deleted (CNT-005).

404.description: No such comment, or the caller may not see it

delete.summary: Deletes a comment; a placeholder stays and it can be restored (CNT-005).

patch.summary: Changes a comment's text or audience (CNT-004).

400.description: Empty or too long text, unknown audience

409.description: Changed by someone else, deleted, or the project is archived

post.summary: Brings a deleted comment back with its text and audience (CNT-005).
Confirms an address from a verification link (AUTH-014).

404.description: Unknown or used link, or the account has another address now

get.summary:
Fields of the instance in its order (FLD-022, FLD-025). Needs `system.read` or
`project.update` in a project.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name or an alias, in any letter case.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.description: `true`: only fields no project uses; `false`: only used ones.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

post.summary: Creates a field of the instance (FLD-015). Needs `system.write`.

get.summary: One field.

delete.summary: Deletes a field from every project and the instance (FLD-023). Needs `system.write`.

patch.summary:
Changes a field (FLD-016…FLD-020). Name and aliases: `system.write`, or `project.update` in
every project using a field that is not attached automatically; the rest: `system.write`.

get.summary: The boards using a field (BRD-022): those the caller views, by name, and how many others.
What deleting a field takes away (FLD-023). Needs `system.write`.

post.summary: Moves a field in the instance order (FLD-022). Needs `system.write`.

get.summary: The projects using a field (FLD-025): those the caller may see, and how many others.

A file by a signed link (CNT-026). No session: the link names the person it was made for, and
their access now decides. Any problem answers 404.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Whom the link was made for.

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: Until when it works, Unix seconds.

parameters.name: thumb
parameters.description: The thumbnail rather than the file.

404.description: No such file, or the link does not work

get.summary:
Groups, built-in ones first, then by name (ACC-022): groups of people, project teams or both.
Needs `system.read` or `project.update` in a project.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name, in any letter case.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Groups of people (default), project teams, or both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

post.summary: Creates an empty group (ACC-023).
Deletes groups (ACC-032): roles revoked, members leave, IDs resolve to the replacement.

400.description: The replacement is among the deleted

409.description: A built-in group, or the last administrator

post.summary: What deleting groups would take away (ACC-032).

get.summary: One group; the ID of a deleted group answers with its replacement (ACC-013).

patch.summary: Changes name, description and auto-join (ACC-024).

409.description: Changed meanwhile, or a built-in group's name

get.summary: Members by name (ACC-026); built-in groups list every account they include.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name, in any letter case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

post.summary: Adds accounts (ACC-026); needs every permission the group gives (ACC-050).

403.description: Missing permissions, named in the answer

post.summary: Removes accounts (ACC-026).

409.description: A built-in group, or the last administrator

get.summary: The process is up. Fails only when the process cannot answer at all.

The node can serve requests: startup is complete, migrations are applied and the database
answers.

post.summary:
Joins from an invitation: chooses a password (and optionally a name and username), verifies
the address and signs in (ACC-004).

get.summary:
Issues matching a query, in its order (QRY-001…QRY-092). Without `q` every issue the caller
may see, most recently updated first; `project` alone lists that project.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
The query, such as `assignee: me is: unresolved sort: priority`; empty or absent is every
issue the caller may see.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Search within this project: its issues, its field names.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Search among the issues with this tag.

parameters.name: saved_search
parameters.description:
Search among the issues of this saved search, as the caller sees them. When its own query
fails, the answer is `invalid_query` without places in `q`; the saved search itself shows
where.

parameters.name: hide_resolved
parameters.description: Leave resolved issues out unless the query itself is about resolution.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA zone that dates such as `today` are read in; the instance's zone by default.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page of the same query.

400.description: The query has errors (`invalid_query`), or a bad limit, cursor or time zone

post.summary: Creates an issue, or a draft with `draft: true` (ISS-002, ISS-005…ISS-007).

400.description: Invalid values or missing required fields

post.summary:
Several issues by internal ID (ISS-001): readable published issues and the caller's drafts, in
the order asked; missing ones are left out.

Clones issues into the caller's drafts (AUT-066): the same copies without numbers, ready in
the drafts menu. Sources the caller cannot read are skipped; a readable source whose project
refuses cloning refuses the whole request.

200.description: The drafts, in the order asked

403.description: No create right, or cloning is off in a source's project

get.summary: How many issues match a query: all and unresolved (QRY-092).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
The query, such as `assignee: me is: unresolved sort: priority`; empty or absent is every
issue the caller may see.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Search within this project: its issues, its field names.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Search among the issues with this tag.

parameters.name: saved_search
parameters.description:
Search among the issues of this saved search, as the caller sees them. When its own query
fails, the answer is `invalid_query` without places in `q`; the saved search itself shows
where.

parameters.name: hide_resolved
parameters.description: Leave resolved issues out unless the query itself is about resolution.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA zone that dates such as `today` are read in; the instance's zone by default.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page of the same query.

post.summary:
Counts of up to 50 queries at once (QRY-092). A read with a body: the queries do not fit a URL.
An invalid query gets its problems in its place; the others still count.

200.description: Counts in the order of the queries

get.summary: The caller's drafts, newest first (ISS-002).

delete.summary: Deletes all of the caller's drafts with their files (ISS-011).

get.summary:
Fields of the projects the caller reads issues in, or of one project (QRY-078): the columns an
issue list may show. Private fields only where the caller reads them (FLD-062).

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Only the fields of this project.

get.summary:
One issue in full, by internal ID or readable ID, current or former (ISS-001…ISS-003). The
answer's `readable_id` is the current one: when it differs from the one asked for, the issue
moved or its project's key changed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal ID or readable ID such as `WEB-12`

404.description: No such issue, or the caller may not see it

delete.summary:
Deletes an issue (ISS-028): it leaves every list and stays whole for the trash. A draft goes
for good.

patch.summary:
Changes summary, description and audience (ISS-018, ISS-041). Text edits carry the
`text_version` they started from: if someone changed the texts meanwhile, the answer is
`conflict` and the client shows both versions (ISS-051).

409.description: The texts changed meanwhile, or the project is archived

get.summary:
A page of the issue's activity stream: comments and change records (HIST-001…HIST-011,
CNT-005, CNT-007), without what the caller may not see.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The item to start after (excluded); omit for the newest (`older`) or oldest (`newer`).

schema.description: Which way an activity page goes.

parameters.name: around_comment
parameters.description:
The page around this comment instead: the comment, older and newer items, newest first
(CNT-007). `from` and `direction` are ignored.

404.description: No such issue, or no such comment to go to

get.summary:
The files of an issue the caller sees, its comments' included, oldest first (CNT-017,
CNT-018).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last ID of the previous page.

post.summary:
Attaches the caller's staged uploads to an issue or draft (CNT-017, ISS-007). Names already on
the issue get ` (2)`, ` (3)`… before the extension.

403.description: No right to change the issue or `attachment.create`

409.description: Too many files, or the project is archived

get.summary:
The boards and sprints of an issue (BRD-033, ISS-020); for a draft also the boards it joins
on its own when published (ISS-007).

post.summary:
Puts an issue on a board (BRD-033, ISS-020): into the sprint given, else the current one. A
draft kept off a board it joins on its own is let back on.

400.description: The issue's project is not on the board

403.description: May not update the issue, a query board, or no current sprint

404.description: No such issue, board or sprint

delete.summary:
Takes an issue off a board (BRD-033, ISS-020); a draft is kept off a board it would join on
its own (ISS-007).

403.description: May not update the issue, or a query board

404.description: No such issue or board, or the issue is not on it

post.summary:
Clones an issue into a published copy of the same project (AUT-066): the summary gains a
«(copy)» suffix, every field value, the audience and the caller's own tags come along;
comments, files, links, votes, watchers and history do not. Needs read of the source,
`issue.create` there and the project's `clone_issue` toggle on.

400.description: The summary with its suffix is too long

403.description: No create right, or cloning is off in the project

post.summary: Posts a comment on an issue (CNT-001, CNT-003).

400.description: Empty or too long text, unknown audience

409.description: A draft, or the project is archived

put.summary: Sets one field's value at once (ISS-019); `null` clears it.

400.description: Not a value of the field, or it cannot be empty

409.description: A computed field, or the project is archived

post.summary: Adds values to a multi-valued field (FLD-001).

get.summary: What a field of an issue may hold for the caller (FLD-001…FLD-014), filtered by `q`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a name, username or value name.

post.summary: Removes values from a multi-valued field (FLD-001).

get.summary:
An issue's links the caller may see (LNK-004, LNK-010): grouped by link type and side,
unresolved first, the first ten of each group.

post.summary:
Links issues to this one (LNK-003, LNK-005, LNK-013): `issue.link` here (or being its
reporter), reading the others, both projects active. Pairs linked already are reported in
`existing`.

400.description: No issues, too many, or the issue itself

404.description: No such issue or link type

409.description: An archived project, a second parent (`parent_taken`), a loop (`link_cycle`), or too many links

get.summary: A page of one group of an issue's links (LNK-010): one link type seen from one side.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: The issue's side; `source` for undirected types

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omit for the first page.

404.description: No such issue or link type

delete.summary: Removes a link from both of its issues (LNK-008).

200.description: Removed, with what the rules said

get.summary:
Whom the mention list offers while typing `@` in an issue's text (CNT-054): people who can see
the issue. Empty for callers who may not see the directory.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a name or username, as typed after `@`.

post.summary:
Moves an issue to another project (ISS-025): the target's next number; the old ID keeps
leading to it.

409.description: The same project, or a project is archived

get.summary: What moving an issue to another project would do (ISS-025).

409.description: The same project, or a project is archived

get.summary:
What the issue page shows on opening, in one request: the issue as `GET /issues/{id}`, the
first page of its activity as `GET /issues/{id}/activity` with the same parameters, its links
as `GET /issues/{id}/links` and its files as `GET /issues/{id}/attachments`. The ID may be a
readable one, current or former, as for `GET /issues/{id}`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal ID or readable ID such as `WEB-12`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The item to start after (excluded); omit for the newest (`older`) or oldest (`newer`).

schema.description: Which way an activity page goes.

parameters.name: around_comment
parameters.description:
The page around this comment instead: the comment, older and newer items, newest first
(CNT-007). `from` and `direction` are ignored.

404.description: No such issue, or no such comment to go to

post.summary: Publishes a draft (ISS-002): it gets the project's next number.

400.description: No summary or missing required fields

409.description: Published already, or the project is archived

put.summary: Stars the issue: the caller watches it (ISS-030).

delete.summary: Unstars the issue (ISS-030).

put.summary: Puts one of the caller's tags on the issue (ISS-035).

409.description: Too many tags, or the project is archived

delete.summary: Takes one of the caller's tags off the issue (ISS-035).

put.summary: Votes for the issue (ISS-032); not for one's own.

409.description: The caller reported it, or it is a draft

delete.summary: Withdraws the caller's vote (ISS-032).

409.description: The caller reported it, or it is a draft

get.summary:
Who watches an issue (NTF-015): people, as the audience candidates endpoint answers them.
Needs `issue.watchers.read` in the issue's project.

200.description: The watchers, in the order they came

put.summary:
Replaces the watcher list (NTF-016): the whole new list, the caller included. Moving anyone
but the caller needs `issue.watchers.update` in the issue's project.

200.description: The watchers now, in the order they came

400.description: No such account in the list

get.summary:
The link types (LNK-001, LNK-018): those in use for everyone signed in; deleted ones and usage
counts for holders of `system.read`.

post.summary: Creates a link type (LNK-019). Needs `system.write`.

delete.summary:
Puts a link type in the trash (LNK-021): its links are hidden until it is restored. Needs
`system.write`.

409.description: Built in and locked (`link_type_locked`), or deleted already

patch.summary:
Changes a link type (LNK-020): renames apply to every link at once. Built-in locked types do
not change. Needs `system.write`.

409.description: Changed meanwhile, deleted, locked (`link_type_locked`) or its links break the hierarchy rules (`hierarchy_conflict`)

get.summary: How many links deleting a link type hides (LNK-021). Needs `system.write`.

post.summary: Takes a link type out of the trash with its links. Needs `system.write`.

400.description: Another type took one of its names meanwhile

post.summary: Renders a text as it would be stored, with what its markers stand for for the caller.

get.summary:
The caller's inbox (NTF-048, NTF-049, plan §3.5): without `issue`, thread heads — one per
issue, its newest row — with the thread's newest rows inline, newest first, paged by the
cursor; with `issue`, that thread's rows. The `system` folder is served only to people who
see the administration area.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description:
`all` (default), `direct` (mentions), `subscriptions` (tags and saved searches) or
`system` (only people who see the administration area).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The previous page's `next` cursor: rows before it.

parameters.name: issue
parameters.description: One issue's whole thread, regardless of paging.

400.description: An unknown folder or unread value

403.description: The system folder without the administration area

post.summary:
Marks rows read or unread (NTF-050): these `ids`, one `issue` thread or `all`; answers the
new unread counts and tells the caller's open tabs over the `inbox:` topic.

get.summary: The caller's subscriptions on tags and saved searches (NTF-021), oldest first.

post.summary:
Subscribes the caller to a tag or a saved search they can see (NTF-023). A source the caller
cannot see answers `forbidden`; kinds the source does not take answer `invalid` (NTF-022).

400.description: Kinds the source does not take, or already subscribed

403.description: The source is not visible to the caller

put.summary:
Changes the kinds of the caller's subscription (NTF-024): an empty list keeps it stored but
delivering nothing.

400.description: Kinds the source does not take

404.description: No such subscription of the caller

delete.summary: Removes the caller's subscription (NTF-024).

404.description: No such subscription of the caller

get.summary: The unread counts of the inbox folders (the badge, NTF-048).

post.summary:
Asks for a password-reset link (AUTH-008). The answer is the same whether or not an account has
the address; the link goes only to a verified address, at most once a minute.

202.description: If an account has this verified address, a link is on its way

post.summary: Sets a new password from a reset link and signs in; every other session ends (AUTH-008).

201.description: Signed in with the new password

get.summary: The permission catalog (ACC-034): every permission with what it implies. Needs only a sign-in.

Projects the caller may see (PRJ-010, PRJ-012, PRJ-013): active ones with the caller's
favorites first, archived ones, or those being deleted that the caller may delete.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name or the start of the key, in any letter case.

schema.description: Which part of the project list (PRJ-013).

parameters.name: in_teams
parameters.description: Only projects whose team includes the caller, directly or through a group.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to the endpoint's maximum (at most 200); default 50.

parameters.name: cursor

CardBatchAnswer.description: Their cards in the order asked (`null`: not on the board for the caller), and their issues.

oneOf.description: The field gets this value (added to a multi-valued field); names are in the card's issue.

CardChange.description: A field change that makes an issue match a query board (BRD-028).

CardField.description: A field value on a card.

ids.description: Values of a set, accounts or groups by ID, as the field's kind says (`refs`).

CardIssue.description:
An issue as its card shows it (BRD-058, ISS-024): a board answers hundreds, so this is the
compact form, not the issue of lists (D-044): only fields that hold a value, with what they
name listed once per answer in `refs`. Markdown text fields are left out.

can_update.description: The caller may change the issue: move its card, edit it on the card.

excerpt.description:
The start of the description (its first three lines, at most 300 characters), Markdown
as written: the largest card size shows it.

files.description: Files of the issue itself the caller sees (medium cards and up, BRD-058).

restricted.description: Limited to an audience (ISS-042): the card shows a lock.

starred.description: The caller watches the issue (NTF-014): the card menu offers to watch or unwatch.

CardMove.description:
Where a card goes (BRD-068, BRD-069): its column, and its neighbours in the shared order
(neither: it keeps its place). `version` is the issue's version the caller saw.

lane.description:
The lane it goes to (BRD-050, BRD-051): sets the lane's value, clears it for `other`, or
changes the parent; absent keeps its lane. Project and date lanes refuse it.

q.description: The header filter the caller sees: with a sort clause `after` and `before` are refused.

CardRefs.description: What the cards of an answer name, each once.

CellDraft.description:
The caller's draft of a cell (BRD-077): kept until it is published or deleted. Open it like
any draft (`GET /issues/{id}`); it is a card of the sprint already and shows once published.

created.description: Made now, rather than the kept one.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: A new password for the caller.

ChangeValues.description:
What left or came with a change. Only the members of the change's kind are filled: `texts`
for summaries, descriptions, strings, dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and times (RFC 3339); `numbers`
for numbers and durations (minutes); `values`, `users`, `groups` for fields with values and
audiences; `tags`; `place` for moves; `files` for attachments; `links` for links (only those to
issues the caller may see).

boards.description: The board place of a `boards` record, with the names it had.

files.description: Files of an `attachments` record, with the names they had.

ChangedMembers.description: The accounts a change applied to.

users.description: Accounts that were added or removed; the others were already so.

CloneDraftsAnswer.description: The drafts made by cloning, in the order asked (AUT-066).

CloneDraftsRequest.description: Issues to clone as the caller's drafts (AUT-066).

CloneOfRef.description: The original issue a clone's `created` record names (AUT-066).

oneOf.description: The original as the viewer may see it; `null` when the viewer may not read it.

readable.description: Whether the viewer may open the original.

count.description: Cards in the column, the hidden ones included.

estimate.description: Their estimation (BRD-062); `null` without an estimation field.

Comment.description:
A comment (CNT-001). A deleted one is a placeholder (CNT-005): author, time and `deleted`;
its text, HTML and audience are empty.

audience.description:
Whom it is limited to, inside the issue's audience; both empty: the same people as the
issue (CNT-003).

files.description: The files posted with it that the caller sees (CNT-018); empty when deleted.

html.description: The text rendered; see `TextRefs` for its markers.

CommentAbilities.description: What the caller may do with a comment.

CommentAnswer.description: The comment after posting, with what the project's rules said (AUT-023, step 1.9).

CommentDeletion.description: When and by whom a comment was deleted.

CommentItem.description: A comment in the stream, at its posting (HIST-006).

id.description: The record's ID: a cursor of the stream.

CommentPatch.description: Changes of a comment (CNT-004); absent fields stay.

add_uploads.description: The caller's staged uploads to add (CNT-018).

oneOf.description: Empty lists: the same people as the issue.

version.description: The version the edit started from.

CountItem.description: The count of one query, or why it could not run.

CountQuery.description: One query of a batch of counts.

CountsAnswer.description: The counts in the order of the queries.

CountsRequest.description: Up to 50 queries to count at once, such as the lists of a sidebar.

CreatedApiToken.description: A created token with its secret.

secret.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. Shown only now; store it safely.

avatar_url.description: The uploaded avatar (ACC-017); `null` shows the generated one.

DateFormat.description: One of the four ways dates and times are shown (ADM-016).

Deletion.description: A deletion in progress, shown to those who may delete the project.

error.description: What went wrong, for a failed deletion.

DeletionState.description: Where the background deletion of a project is (PRJ-065).

DisabledLabel.description: The word shown with a disabled account; every label has the same effect (ACC-005).

DisabledState.description: Why and since when an account is disabled.

EffectiveRole.description: One role a person holds at one scope, with all its sources (ACC-018, ACC-061).

permissions.description: The permissions it gives at this scope.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason; the UI shows its own translated text for it.

fields.description: Problems with individual parameters or body fields; present only for `invalid_request`.

message.description: English explanation for developers and logs; not meant to be shown to users as is.

missing_permissions.description: Permission keys the caller lacks; present only for some `forbidden` answers (ACC-050).

problems.description: The problems of a query with their places in its text; present only for `invalid_query`.

ErrorCode.description: Why a request failed. Each code has one HTTP status.

aliases.description: Other words for it in searches and commands (FLD-017).

auto_attach.description: Attached to every new blank project (FLD-020).

can_be_empty.description: What a new attachment starts with (FLD-019).

default_users.description: Default accounts of a user field.

oneOf.description: The set new attachments share or copy.

FieldBoardUse.description: How a board uses a field (BRD-022).

items.description: The boards the caller views, by name.

others.description: Boards using it that the caller does not view.

FieldDeletionImpact.description: What deleting a field takes away (FLD-023).

issues.description: Issues that lose a value of it.

FieldError.description: One invalid parameter or body field.

code.description:
Machine-readable reason: `required`, `invalid`, `too_short`, `too_long`, `out_of_range`,
`taken` (another record uses the value), `incorrect` (does not match what is stored, such
as a current password), `unknown` (an unexpected field).

path.description: Parameter name or path of the body field, such as `limit` or `values.2.name`.

FieldOptions.description:
What a field of an issue may hold for the caller (FLD-001…FLD-014). Only the member of the
field's kind is filled.

can_add_value.description: The caller may add a value to the field's set from the picker.

more.description: More options match than were answered.

set.description: The field's set, where a value added from the picker goes (`POST /value-sets/{id}/values`).

users.description: People of a user field's set by name, the caller first when they qualify.

values.description: Values of the field's set in its order, without archived ones.

FieldPatch.description:
Changes of a field; absent fields stay. Name and aliases are shared by every project; the
rest is what new attachments start with.

version.description: The version the change was made on.

FieldValueChange.description: A new value of one field (ISS-019).

oneOf.description: `null` clears the field.

FieldValueInput.description:
A value as sent: the field's kind says how it is read. A number or a list of IDs for fields
with values (one ID for single fields); a number for numbers and durations (minutes); text for
strings, Markdown, dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`), date-times (RFC 3339) and durations (`1h 30m`).

FieldValuesChange.description: Values to add to or remove from a multi-valued field (FLD-001).

FileRef.description:
A file a text names (`tf-file:` markers): an attachment of the issue the caller sees, or for
a preview one of the caller's uploads.

name.description: The name as the text writes it.

Group.description: A group of the list or the group page (ACC-022).

members.description: Accounts in it; for a team, with the members of its groups.

team_of.description: The project whose team this is (PRJ-047).

GroupDeletion.description: Groups to delete and the one that takes their place (ACC-032).

GroupPatch.description: Changes of a group's settings (ACC-024); absent fields stay.

name.description: A team's name is its project's name.

team_of.description: The project whose team this is (PRJ-047); its members change on that project's people page.

HealthKind.description: What is wrong with a board's settings (BRD-023).

HealthSlot.description: The setting a field finding is about.

HeldValue.description: A value of a set as an issue holds it.

description.description: Shown as a hint when the value is picked (FLD-043).

HistoryItem.description: One record of the change history (HIST-001…HIST-005).

after_comment.description:
The comment this change is shown under: its author changed the issue within a minute
after posting it (HIST-011).

oneOf.description: The original this `created` record names, when the issue was made by cloning (AUT-066).
The field of a `field` record.

id.description: The record's ID: a cursor of the stream.

Inbox.description: One page of the inbox, threads newest first.

next.description: `before` of the next page; `null` on the last.

InboxNotification.description: One row of the inbox (NTF-049): who caused it, why it reached the reader, and what it says.

content.description: What the row says: the change of an issue, or a `system` report.

issue_id.description: The issue the row is about; `null` for `system` rows.

last.description:
The last row before the reader's access to the issue was lost («наблюдение
прекращено», NTF-043); no later rows of that issue arrive until access returns.

reasons.description: Why the row reached the reader: `watch`, `mention`, `tag:<id>`, `search:<id>`.

InboxSummary.description: The unread counts of the folders (the badge, NTF-048).

InboxThread.description:
One thread of the inbox (NTF-049): the head — the thread's newest row — with the thread's
newest rows inline, the head first. `system` rows stand alone.

full_name.description: Replaces the name the invitation started with.

username.description: Replaces the username the invitation started with.

emails.description: Addresses separated by spaces, commas or new lines; up to 100.

Invited.description: The accounts created for invited people.

Issue.description: An issue or draft in full (ISS-001).

created_at.description: Publication time; for a draft, when it was started.

fields.description: The project's fields the caller may see, in the project's order.

oneOf.description:
Its parent through the subtask link type, when the caller may see it (LNK-013). Filled in
answers about one issue; `null` in lists.

readable_id.description:
`KEY-12`; `null` for a draft. Differs from the ID asked for when the issue moved or its
project's key changed (ISS-003).

refs.description:
What the markers of the description and text fields stand for. Filled in answers about
one issue; empty in lists.

resolved_at.description: Set while the issue is resolved (ISS-023).

subtasks.description: Its subtasks the caller may see (LNK-014).

text_version.description: Send it with edits of the summary or description (ISS-051).

IssueAbilities.description: What the caller may do with an issue.

update.description: Change summary, description, public fields, tags and audience.

IssueAnswer.description: The issue after a change that can fire behaviors, with what they said (AUT-023, step 1.9).

IssueBatch.description: Issues read at once: in the order asked, without those missing or not readable.

IssueBoard.description: A board and sprint holding an issue (BRD-033, ISS-020).

auto.description: A draft joins this board on its own when published (ISS-007).

skipped.description: The draft is kept off it: it will not join when published.

oneOf.description: `null` on a sprintless board.

IssueBoards.description: The boards of an issue the caller views.

IssueBrief.description: An issue at the other end of a link, or a parent.

IssueCount.description: How many issues the caller sees.

IssueField.description:
One field of an issue with its value (FLD-001…FLD-014). Only the member of the field's kind
is filled; an empty field has none.

html.description: Text fields rendered (D-031); markers are explained by the issue's `refs`.

values.description: Enumeration, state, version, build and owned fields, in the set's order.

IssueFieldInput.description: A field value of a new issue.

oneOf.description: `null` leaves the field empty instead of its default.

IssueFields.description: Fields of the projects the caller reads issues in (QRY-078): the issue list's columns.

items.description: Most used first (by how many of those projects have the field), then the instance order.

IssueImpact.description: How many issues an action on a field or value touches (FLD-032, FLD-054).

IssueLinks.description:
An issue's links the caller may see (LNK-004, LNK-010): groups in the order of the link types,
the source side first.

can_link.description: The caller may add and remove links here.

IssueMention.description: An issue ID in a text that names an issue the caller may see (CNT-056).

token.description: As written, which may be a former ID.

IssuePage.description:
What the issue page shows on opening, in one answer: the issue, the first page of its
activity (by the `ActivityQuery` parameters), its links and its files.

boards.description: The boards and sprints holding it (BRD-033).

IssuePatch.description: Changes of texts and audience (ISS-018, ISS-041); absent fields stay.

text_version.description: The `text_version` the edit started from; required with a summary or description.

IssuePlace.description: An issue's place before or after a move.

oneOf.description: `null` when the caller may not see that project.

IssueSearchPage.description: A page of issues matching a query.

live_topic.description:
The live topic of this list: subscribe to it to hear about changes of issues this list
can contain (see QRY-086).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` with the same query for the next page; `null` on the last page.

notes.description: Notes about the query, such as a toggle it overrides.

single_id.description: The query is one issue ID: a client may open that issue instead of a list.

sort.description: The order used, ending with the tie-breaker.

JobProgress.description: How far a job has come (ADM-031).

total.description: Steps in total; `None` when the job cannot tell yet.

count.description: Cards in the lane, the hidden ones included.

estimate.description:
Their estimation (BRD-062) in the estimation field's unit (minutes for durations); `null`
without an estimation field.

issue.description: The parent issue of a parent lane; its card form is in `issues`.

LaneAttribute.description: An issue attribute that makes value lanes (BRD-050).

LaneLabel.description: The name of a lane key (BRD-053).

color.description: The color of a value or a tag.

LaneMove.description: Where a parent lane goes among the lanes (BRD-053); neither neighbour: last.

LaneRemoved.description: The issues a parent lane took back to the backlog (BRD-056).

Limits.description: Limits the browser checks before sending a request.

upload_max_bytes.description:
Largest file one upload may have, in bytes: the administrators' setting within the
server's ceiling (CNT-019).

LinkDirection.description: How a link type joins issues (LNK-001).

LinkGroup.description: The links of one name on an issue: one type seen from one side (LNK-010).

items.description: Unresolved issues first, then the newest links; the first ten in a panel.

name.description: The name of this side, such as "parent of".

next_cursor.description: Pass to the group's endpoint for the next rows; `null` when there are none.

side.description: The issue's side; `source` for undirected types.

LinkInfo.description: What a link is for, before it is used.

expired.description: The link no longer works; a new one is needed.

LinkSide.description: Which end of a link an issue is.

LinkToken.description: The secret of an emailed link: the part of its address after `#`.

deleted_at.description: In the trash: its links are hidden until it is restored.

locked.description: Built in and relied on: cannot be changed or deleted.

usage.description: How many links it has; `null` without `system.read`.

LinkTypeImpact.description: What deleting a link type hides (LNK-021).

LinkTypeList.description: All link types, oldest first; deleted ones only for holders of `system.read`.

LinkTypePatch.description: Changes of a link type (LNK-020); omitted members stay. Renames apply to every link at once.

oneOf.description:
Becoming `undirected` drops the target name; becoming `hierarchy` is refused while links
of the type give a target several sources or form a loop.

target_name.description: Needed when an undirected type becomes directed.

version.description: The version the change started from.

LinkTypeRef.description: A link type as a reference.

source_name.description: How the source refers to the target.

target_name.description: How the target refers to the source; `null` for undirected types.

LinkedIssue.description: A link as one issue's panel shows it.

link.description: The link's ID, for removing it.

existing.description: Issues that had a link of this type with the issue already.

messages.description: What the project's rules said (AUT-023, step 1.9).
What the project's rules said (AUT-023, step 1.9).

oneOf.description: Asks for a `pong`, to detect a dead connection.

LiveDenied.description:
These topics cannot be subscribed: unknown, malformed, or about something the user cannot see.
The reasons are not told apart, so the answer never reveals that a hidden object exists.

LiveEntity.description: The entity an event is about.

kind.description: Entity type in snake_case, such as `issue`, `comment` or `article`; grows with features.

version.description: The entity's version after the change (for `deleted`: its last version).

LiveEvent.description: One committed change of one entity, checked against the receiver's permissions.

id.description:
Position in the instance-wide event sequence, the same on every node. Increases in commit
order; the client sends the last one it saw as `since` after a reconnect.

patch.description:
New values of the changed fields (for `created`: all fields) in the entity's full API shape,
when they are small and safe to send to this receiver; otherwise `null` and the client
fetches the entity if it keeps it. Always `null` for `deleted`; for now set only on
`card_order` events (`board:` topics).

topics.description:
The receiver's subscribed topics this change belongs to; one message even when it matches
several of them.

LiveResync.description:
Events of these topics were missed and cannot be replayed: the client reloads what it shows
for them. The topics stay subscribed.

oneOf.description: Answer to `ping`.

LiveSubscribe.description:
Start receiving events of these topics. The server answers `subscribed` with the topics it
accepted and `denied` with the rest.

since.description:
ID of the last event the client received, sent when it subscribes again after a
reconnect. The server first replays the later events of these topics; when it no longer
has them it answers `resync` instead. `null` for a fresh subscription.

topics.description: Topics to add; topics already subscribed are accepted again.

LiveSubscribed.description:
These topics are active: every later change of them is delivered (and, after `since`, the
missed ones were replayed before this message).

head.description:
ID of the latest event at this moment. Every earlier event of these topics is either
already delivered or older than the data the client can load now, so the client keeps the
larger of this and its last event ID as its `since` for the next reconnect.

LiveUnsubscribe.description: Stop receiving events of these topics. Unknown topics are ignored.

Liveness.description: The process is up and answering.

LoggedBoard.description: A board, and the sprint of a sprint board, named by history (names as they were).

LoggedLink.description:
A link named by history (HIST-005): its type with the current names, the side of the issue
the record belongs to, and the issue at the other end.

name.description: The name of that side, such as "child of".

LoggedValue.description: A value of a set named by history; its name is the one it had then.

color.description: Current color; `null` also when the value is gone.

MailSettings.description:
The mail settings as the administration screen sees them (NTF-004). No secret value is ever
part of an answer.

configured.description: Whether a transport exists at all, switch or not.

email_enabled.description: The instance email switch as it stands (NTF-002): while off, nothing is sent or queued.

has_password.description: Whether an SMTP password is stored; its value is a secret.

has_smtp_url.description: Whether an SMTP URL is stored; its value is a secret.

has_username.description: Whether an SMTP user name is stored; its value is a secret.

mail_from.description: The sender of every email (NTF-006); empty when nothing is set.

mail_reply_to.description: Where replies go; empty means replies go to the sender (NTF-006).

source.description: Where the transport of this node comes from.

MailSettingsChange.description:
A change of the mail settings (NTF-004). Secret fields are write-only: the field absent keeps
the stored value, `null` clears it, a string stores it.

email_enabled.description: The instance email switch (NTF-002); switching on needs a working transport.

mail_from.description: The sender of every email (NTF-006); empty turns to the environment's, else the default.

mail_reply_to.description: Where replies go; empty means replies go to the sender (NTF-006).

smtp_password.description: The SMTP password (a provider's app password when 2-step verification is on).

smtp_url.description: `smtp://host:port` or `smtps://host:port`, credentials optional in the URL.

smtp_username.description: The SMTP user name, when the server wants one the URL does not carry.

MailSource.description: Where the outgoing mail transport of the instance comes from.

to.description: Any address; the transport's complaint, if any, comes back in full.

issue.description:
The issue the text belongs to; must be visible to the caller. Its files show where the
text names them.

uploads.description: The caller's staged uploads the text may name (CNT-034).

MembersChange.description: Accounts to add to a group or remove from it (ACC-026).

Message.description: What a rule told the actor (§3.11); the web shows each as a toast (§3.13).

code.description: What happened; the texts live in the web.

params.description: The values the text names; the keys belong to the code.

rule.description: The rule's key, the one `GET /projects/{id}/rules` names.

MoveAfter.description: Where to move something in an order: right after another item, or first.

MoveOutcome.description: What happens to a value on a move (FLD-059).

loses_access.description: The caller could not see the issue afterwards.

MoveResult.description: The issue after a move; `null` when the caller cannot see it there.

messages.description: What the project's rules said (AUT-023, step 1.9).

NeedView.description: One thing a rule lacks (§3.11): a code the web renders and the values its text names.

code.description: `field` (a field to attach) or `value` (a value the set lacks).

params.description:
The values the text names: `kind` and `name` for a field, `field` and `value` for a
value; `value` is absent when any value does.

must_change_password.description: Ask for a new password at the first sign-in (AUTH-010).

name.description: What the token is for, such as the name of a script; up to 100 characters.

NewAssignment.description: Assigns a role to an account or a group at one or more scopes (ACC-059, ACC-060).

uploads.description: Staged uploads of the caller, in the order to attach.

NewBoardColumn.description: A column to add: a value of the column field's set, or a new value by name.

after.description: The column it follows; absent puts it last.

new_value.description: A new value of the set (FLD-031 rights; it shows in every project using the set).

NewCard.description: An issue to add to a sprint of the board (BRD-025); `column` also sets its column value.

after.description: The card it follows in the shared order; with neither neighbour it goes last.

lane.description: The lane it is dropped into: sets the lane's value or parent.

preview.description:
A query board (BRD-028): answer the field changes that make the issue match and change
nothing.

subtasks.description:
A parent joining a parent-lane board becomes a lane (it holds a lane value, or has
subtasks when no field limits the parents); `true` brings its subtasks as cards.

NewCellDraft.description: The cell whose «+» opens the new-issue form (BRD-077).

lane.description: The lane of the cell, on a board with lanes.

project.description:
The project of a new draft; absent takes the lane's project, else the first board project
the caller creates issues in.

oneOf.description: Omit for the same people as the issue.

uploads.description: The caller's staged uploads to post with it (CNT-018); then `text` may be empty.

default_values.description: Only with an existing set: values of it, or accounts for user fields.

name.description: Up to 100 characters without `<`, `>`, `/`, `:`; unique for its type.

oneOf.description: For kinds with values; a new empty set when absent.
A new empty set; named after the field when no name is given.
An existing set of the same kind, such as another field's.

NewFieldSet.description: Where a new field takes its values from (FLD-015).

oneOf.description: Omit for the project's default audience.

draft.description: Keep it as a draft instead of publishing.

fields.description: Values instead of the project's defaults.

links.description: Links to existing issues (ISS-009, LNK-006, LNK-007), such as the parent of a new subtask.

tags.description: The caller's tags to put on it.

uploads.description: The caller's staged uploads to attach (ISS-007, CNT-017).

watchers.description: People to watch it; others than the caller need `issue.watchers.update`.

NewIssueBoard.description: Puts an issue on a board: into `sprint`, else the board's current sprint.

NewIssueLink.description: A link made together with a new issue (ISS-009, LNK-006, LNK-007).

side.description: The new issue's side: `target` makes it a subtask of `issue` with the subtask type.

NewLane.description: A new parent lane (BRD-054): an issue with this summary in the first board project.

target_name.description: Required unless `direction` is `undirected`, which ignores it.

first_number.description: Number of the first issue; 1 when absent.

key.description:
Latin letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, 2–10 characters; stored in capitals.
Absent or empty: suggested from the name.

name.description: Up to 100 characters, unique ignoring case.
Up to 100 characters; not a predefined role's name.

auto_target.description: New issues join the new sprint; the board's mode becomes `auto` (BRD-026).

carry_from.description: Carry the unresolved issues of this sprint to the new one (BRD-101).

NewValue.description: A value to add (FLD-032). Properties of other kinds are refused.

after.description: Right after this value; at the end when absent.

NotificationBody.description: What a row says, in one of the two shapes rows have.

NotificationChange.description: What an issue row says: the issue and the lines its reader may see, rendered at fire time.

NotificationIssue.description: The issue a row names: its readable ID (`WEB-12`) and summary.

NotificationKind.description:
The kinds of events (NTF-022). `system` is what the server itself tells a person (job
reports); it never appears in a subscription.

NotificationLine.description: One rendered line of a row: plain text, a field change or a comment excerpt.

NotificationRead.description:
Marks rows read or unread (NTF-050): exactly one selector — these `ids`, one `issue` thread
or `all`.

unread.description: `true` marks the rows unread again; the default marks them read.

NotificationReport.description: What a `system` row says: a job report. `state` is a stable key (`finished`, `failed`).

NotificationSettings.description:
A person's notification settings (NTF-017, NTF-030, NTF-034, NTF-066): the email channel and
its form, own changes, mentions, the kinds of the built-in watch subscription, and the
auto-watch switches (ISS-030). The inbox channel is always on, so it has no switch here.
